description: Implement Product Stock Management with automatic stock decrease on order, out-of-stock indicators, low stock warnings, and admin alerts. Prevents overselling and improves inventory visibility for both users and admin.
steps: Add updateProductStock(productId, quantityDelta) function to database.js that finds product, updates stock (product.stock += quantityDelta), validates stock doesn't go negative, saves to localStorage, returns updated product or null if not found
Add getLowStockProducts(threshold = 10) function to database.js that returns getProducts().filter(p => p.stock < threshold)

In app.js checkout flow (checkoutButton handler), after addOrder() succeeds, iterate through cart items and call updateProductStock(productId, -quantity) for each item. Call renderProducts() after to refresh grid.

In renderProducts() function in app.js, add stock level checks: if product.stock === 0, add 'Out of Stock' red badge to product card and disable Add to Cart button (add 'disabled' attribute and opacity:0.5 style). If product.stock < 10 and stock > 0, add 'Only X left!' warning badge in orange below price.
In addToCart() function, add stock validation: get product, check if cart[id] + 1 > product.stock. If true, show toast 'Cannot add more - only X in stock' and return early without adding.

In admin dashboard loadAdminData() function, add low stock alert section after stats-grid. Call getLowStockProducts(), render warning card with icon, count, and list of low stock items with current stock levels. Use admin-note styling with orange background.
Update products table in admin panel to show stock levels in Availability column with conditional styling: stock < 10 orange badge, stock === 0 red badge, stock >= 10 green badge
acceptance_criteria: When user completes checkout, product stock decreases by ordered quantity
Products with stock === 0 show 'Out of Stock' badge and disabled Add to Cart button
Products with stock < 10 show 'Only X left!' warning
User cannot add more items to cart than available stock
Admin dashboard shows low stock alert section with products below 10 units
Admin products table shows color-coded stock levels
Product grid refreshes after order to show updated stock
verification: Find a product with low stock (check admin panel or set stock low manually in localStorage)
Add items to cart until stock warning appears
Try to add more than available - verify error toast
Complete checkout - verify product stock decreased
Refresh page - verify 'Out of Stock' or low stock badge appears
Login as admin - verify low stock alert section shows affected products
Check admin products table - verify stock levels display correctly with color coding
findings: Implementation complete. All stock management features working as expected: updateProductStock and getLowStockProducts functions added to database.js, checkout flow updates stock for each ordered item and refreshes product grid, renderProducts adds out-of-stock red badges with disabled buttons and low stock orange warnings, addToCart validates against available stock and shows error toast when limit reached, admin dashboard displays low stock alert section with warning icon and affected product list, admin products table shows color-coded stock badges (red for out-of-stock, orange for low stock, green for in-stock). CSS styles added for stock-badge, low-stock-alert, low-stock-item, stock-level, and cancelled status classes.
